body:
Over the years, I’ve had some of my loyal critics confidently proclaim what it is that I believe. I would then do some original research and find out that they were about 180 degrees off from what I actually believe. In light of recent claims about President Obama’s faith and theology, I thought this article did a good job of letting the man speak for himself:

 http://www.washingtonpost.com/national/on-faith/president-obamas-theology-in-his-own-words/2012/02/21/gIQAUbqqRR_print.html
